content: द्वन्द्वम् [द्वौ द्वौ सहाभिव्यक्तौ; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>P. VIII. 1. 15. Sk.</ls>] .²1 pair, couple. .²2 A couple of animals (including even men) of different sexes, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} male and female; द्वन्द्वानि भावं क्रियया विवव्रुः <ls>Ku. 3. 35</ls>; <ls>Me. 45</ls>; न चेदिदं द्वन्द्वमयोजयिष्यत् <ls>Ku. 7. 66</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 40</ls>; <ls>Ś. 2. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">7. 27</ls>; अल्पं तुल्यशीलानि द्वन्द्वानि सृज्यन्ते <ls>Pratimā 1</ls>. .²3 A couple of opposite conditions or qualities, (such as सुख and दुःख; शीत and उष्ण); बलवती हि द्वन्द्वानां प्रवृत्तिः <ls>K. 135</ls>; द्वन्द्वैरयोजयच्चेमाः सुखदुःखादिभिः प्रजाः <ls>Ms. 1. 26</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 81</ls>; सर्वर्तुनिर्वृतिकरे निवसन्नुपैति न द्वन्द्वदुःखमिह किंचिदकिंचनोऽपि <ls>Śi. 4. 64</ls>. .²4 A strife, contention, quarrel, dispute, fight. .²5 A duel; <ls>Rām. 6. 43. 15</ls>. .²6 Doubt, uncertainty. .²7 A fortress, stronghold. .²8 A secret. .²9 A secret, or lonely place; द्वन्द्वे ह्येतत् प्रवक्तव्यं हितं वै यद्यवेक्षसे <ls>Rām. 7. 103. 11</ls>. .{@-न्द्वः@} .²1 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) One of the four principal kinds of compounds, in which two or more words are joined together which, if not compounded, would stand in the same case and be connected by the copulative conjunction ‘and’; चार्थे द्वन्द्वः <ls>P. II. 2. 29</ls>; द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च <ls>Bg. 10. 33</ls>; उभयपदप्रधानो द्वन्द्वः <ls>Kāśi. 38</ls>. .²2 A kind of disease. .²3 (in music) A kind of measure. .²4 The sign Gemini of the zodiac.
